text:
Maya K: FYI — Helixera (med AI) wants a 5-day POC to validate our model catalog for clinical note summarization + retrieval. Must-haves: customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, p95 <180ms for single-turn queries, budget target $0.55 / 1k tokens, expect 80k tokens/day. Can we outline variant choices and infra blockers?

Ethan L: For summarization + retrieval I'd run tests on two variants: redwood/llama-13b-qlora (quality) and redwood/llama-13b-q4_0 (cost). If they need <180ms p95 we should plan for dedicated V100/A100 with prefix KV caching and small sequence lengths.

Rohit P: Tokenization caveat  Helixera has legacy EHR char mappings. We'll need a token-diff run on a 5k-sample to catch weird token splits that break prefix hits. AE can they provide 2k anonymized notes?

Maya K: I'll ask for 2k de-identified notes. They also want embeddings stable for semantic search across nightly re-indexing.

Rohit P: Use our stable 1536-d embed service for retrieval. We'll also run 500 pairwise cosine checks between q4_0 and qlora embeddings to measure drift. I'll spin a notebook.

Sasha T: Infra notes: Private VPC + customer KMS is supported. Need infra request for VPC peering and a dedicated shard for the POC. Estimate: 1 x a100-40g for baseline, bump to 2 if they run parallel evaluations. Provisioning ~72 hours after contract. Reserved POC adds ~15-25% premium.

Maya K: Can someone draft quick numbers for procurement? They need a line item for POC infra + projected per-token.

Ethan L: Quick ballpark: shared-hosted q4_0 generation ~ $0.17 / 1k tokens, qlora ~ $0.42 / 1k. With dedicated +20% and prefix caching (we often see ~25% token saving) effective range ~ $0.18-$0.50 / 1k depending on mix. Under their $0.55 target.

Maya K: Great. Also asked about compliance docs (SOC2, data-retention, whether data is stored in our control plane).

sec-bot: Attach SOC2 Type II and latest penetration-test summary. Note: in Private deployments customer data plane remains in their VPC if they choose Private; in Dedicated it's isolated but some metadata may be in our control plane for observability. KMS options: AWS KMS CMK (customer) or BYOK via HSM for Private. Please confirm FIPS requirement.

Sasha T: If they require HSM-only keys + on-prem audit, we escalate to Private on-prem; longer lead times and enterprise pricing. For VPC + AWS-KMS CMK in their account it's straightforward.

Maya K: Action list: (1) I'll request 2k sample notes & security questionnaire answers, (2) Rohit to run tokenizer diff + embed-drift notebook, (3) Sasha to open infra request for dedicated shard & VPC peering, (4) Ethan to assemble POC cost table & simple runbook.

Rohit P: Draft POC config below, will tweak after token sample.

```yaml
model_priority:
  - redwood/llama-13b-q4_0
  - redwood/llama-13b-qlora
instance_profile: a100-40g-dedicated
kv_cache: prefix_enabled
cache_ttl: 24h
max_seq: 1024
quant: q4_0
batching: workload_aware
vpc_peering: required
kms: aws-kms-cmk (customer-account)
monitoring: console + token_traces
slo:
  p95_latency_ms: 180
  uptime_pct: 99.9
fallback_policy: canary_to_hosted_shard
```

Ethan L: Add a note to run warmup prompts to populate prefix cache and a canary traffic route to hosted if shard saturates. Also include token-level cost labels.

Sasha T: Infra ticket SALES-5821 opened (POC Helixera dedicated shard + VPC). ETA 72 hours after approvals. infra-bot linked repo infra/poc-helixera.

infra-bot: Created SALES-5821 and attached provisioning checklist.

Maya K: I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Helixera tomorrow 9am PST. @Rohit @Sasha @Ethan please join. I'll push the procurement estimates as 'preliminary'.

Rohit P: I'll bring tokenizer checklist and sample prep steps.

Sasha T: I'll bring infra timeline + options slide.

Ethan L: I'll prepare a 1-slide cost/variant comparison and the runbook link.

Maya K: :white_check_mark: I'll update once kickoff is done and will close thread.
